title: Developmental Variants
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask what changed and when, because a shape that is improving behaves differently from one that is worsening.
Record the alignment in both planes and whether it is symmetrical, since asymmetry is the finding that matters most.
Record the rotational profile, since in toeing and out toeing are the common presenting complaints.
Measure the limb lengths, because a length difference alongside an angular shape suggests something other than a variant.
Assess generalised laxity, since hyperextension and apparent instability are often part of it.
